We are looking for an experienced Looker Studio Dashboard Developer / Business Intelligence Specialist to build a comprehensive management dashboard for a multi-location business.

The goal is to centralize data from multiple sources into one clear, dynamic, and easy-to-use dashboard. Our managers should be able to monitor the performance of each store individually, compare locations, and review company-wide results with data updated in real or near-real time.

Project Scope

You will design and build a complete management dashboard that may include:

- Incoming and outgoing calls

- Call performance and conversion metrics

- Customer check-ins

- Appointments booked, completed, canceled, and pending

- Sales and operational KPIs

- Store rankings and performance comparisons

- Individual store, regional, and company-wide views

- Daily, weekly, monthly, and custom date-range reporting

- Performance trends and period-over-period comparisons

- Filters by store, manager, employee, date, and other relevant criteria

- Automated data refreshes

- Alerts or visual indicators for underperforming locations or metrics

The final dashboard must be visually clear, fast, reliable, and practical for daily management decisions.

Responsibilities

- Review our current data sources and recommend the best integration structure.

- Connect Looker Studio with Google Sheets, APIs, and other relevant platforms.

- Build automated data pipelines where needed.

- Clean, organize, and standardize information from different sources.

- Create calculated fields, KPIs, scorecards, charts, rankings, and interactive filters.

- Develop store-level and company-wide dashboard views.

- Implement role-appropriate access when different managers need different views.

- Optimize dashboard performance and data-refresh reliability.

- Validate calculations and troubleshoot discrepancies between source systems and reports.

- Document the dashboard structure, data connections, formulas, and refresh process.

- Train our management team on how to use and maintain the dashboard.

Required Qualifications

- Proven experience building advanced dashboards in Google Looker Studio.

- Strong experience connecting Looker Studio to Google Sheets.

- Experience integrating data through APIs.

- Ability to combine and standardize data from multiple platforms.

- Strong knowledge of calculated fields, data blending, filters, parameters, and interactive reports.

- Understanding of business, sales, call-center, and operational KPIs.

- Ability to transform management needs into practical dashboard views.

- Strong attention to data accuracy, usability, and visual organization.

- Ability to work independently and communicate progress clearly.

- Portfolio or examples of similar dashboards.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with multi-location or retail businesses.

- Experience reporting on calls, appointments, check-ins, sales, rankings, and conversion rates.

- Knowledge of BigQuery, SQL, Google Apps Script, or third-party Looker Studio connectors.

- Experience creating secure dashboards with store- or manager-specific access.

- Ability to recommend a scalable data architecture instead of relying exclusively on spreadsheets.

Expected Deliverables

- Fully functional Looker Studio management dashboard.

- Individual store and consolidated company views.

- Automated connections to approved data sources.

- Interactive filters, rankings, comparisons, and performance trends.

- Tested and validated KPIs.

- Technical documentation for connections, formulas, and refresh schedules.

- Management training and final project handoff.

- Post-launch support to resolve initial issues.

To Apply

Please include:

- Examples of advanced Looker Studio dashboards you have created.

- A brief explanation of your experience with APIs and Google Sheets integrations.

- Examples of projects involving multiple stores, locations, or business units.

- The tools or architecture you would consider for reliable data refreshes.

- Your estimated timeline and project fee.

- Your availability for ongoing support after launch.
